svg.title: From one dataflow for the whole workload to one dataflow per stage
svg.desc: Two pipelines of the three attention stages. In the original action space (top) one dataflow, here output-stationary, is applied to all three stages and they run in a single simulator call. In the redesigned per-stage action space (bottom) each stage has its own dataflow and SRAM split, each simulated separately; a token flows through both.

g.text: one (dataflow, SRAM split) applied to the whole workload; one simulator call
one shared choice for all three stages
each stage gets its own (dataflow, SRAM split); three simulator calls, then combined
cost: three simulator calls per candidate instead of one

svg.text: Source: experiments/exp3_main_sweep/results/raw/exp3_perstage.csv · best action of A2C seed 2, seq 256 @ 32×32; os_only baseline
